options: Observe or use evidence, connect it to the concept, and explain the conclusion.

items.question: Explain magnetic and non-magnetic materials and give one everyday example.
items.answer: A strong answer gives an accurate explanation and a relevant example.

flashcards.front: What is magnetic and non-magnetic materials?
flashcards.back: Define magnetic and non-magnetic materials, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define poles, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define attraction and repulsion, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define magnetic fields, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore magnetic and non-magnetic materials
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on magnetic and non-magnetic materials. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where poles is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach magnetic fields to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
